task.description: Independently re-verify REQ-265's marker insertion across 13 lib/letflow/design/ files.

result.note: All 7 independent checks re-derived from scratch, trusting nothing in step-02-doc-updater.json: (1) `git diff 1eb0b14f..HEAD --stat` shows exactly 15 changed files: the 13 in-scope req017-req029 design files plus this run's own step-00/step-02 handoff jsons; 243 insertions, 0 deletions -- no other file touched, no deletions anywhere. (2) Independently grepped 'PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):' and '\.zig' per file: marker counts = req017:10, req018:29, req019:8, req020:15, req021:22, req022:2, req023:21, req024:12, req025:4, req026:9, req027:8, req028:29, req029:7 (sum=176) -- matches DOC-UPDATER's claim exactly. .zig counts identical before (git show 1eb0b14f:<path>) and after for every file (13:13, 37:37, 9:9, 21:21, 25:25, 4:4, 29:29, 22:22, 4:4, 12:12, 11:11, 36:36, 9:9) -- zero citations lost. (3) Diffed each file with marker lines stripped out (before vs after): empty diff for all 13 files -- citation text is byte-identical, only marker lines were added. (4) Re-ran `grep -rnE 'unlike R-Co|deliberately diverges|diverges from R-Co'` against 1eb0b14f and HEAD on req021/req024/req027 (the 3 files DOC-UPDATER named): text is byte-identical (line-number-stripped diff is empty), confirming no divergence-note text was altered -- BUT the actual count is 5 matching lines (req021:1, req024:2, req027:2), not the 4 DOC-UPDATER's report claims ('req021 and req024 x2 and req027 x2' arithmetically totals 5, and my own grep also finds 5). This is a miscount in DOC-UPDATER's self-report, not a defect in the files: the substantive AC (divergence-note text unmodified) holds regardless, since the diff is empty either way. Flagging as a discrepancy to note, not a blocker. (5) `git diff --stat` confirms CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/migration/README.md, and every lib/letflow/design/ file outside the 13-file req017-req029 list are untouched. (6) Table-placement rigor spot-checked directly: req017 section 10's acceptance-criteria table (3 distinct .zig-citing rows, lines 598-601) has exactly one marker at line 595 above the header row, not per-row. req018 section 4.2's column-mapping table (2 .zig-citing rows) has exactly one marker at line 432 above its header at 433. req028 section 2.2's Edge-struct table (0 rows cite .zig directly but adjacent Node/Violation tables and their prose do) -- confirmed each table/paragraph unit that does carry a .zig citation gets exactly one marker immediately above it (lines 109, 118, 127, 137, 146), and the one table with no .zig-bearing cell (section 2.1's Node table, lines 102-106) correctly has no marker, since the following paragraph -- not the table -- carries the citation. No per-row marker duplication found anywhere. (7) Confirmed directly: none of the 13 files has YAML frontmatter (all start with a '# Design: REQ-0NN --' Markdown heading, no leading '---' block) -- the ISS-0510 YAML-shape amendment correctly did not apply, DOC-UPDATER's claim verified true. Verdict: PASS. The one discrepancy found (5 vs claimed 4 divergence-note lines) is a self-report arithmetic error, not a scope, content, or placement defect -- every acceptance criterion in REQ-265 is independently confirmed satisfied: marker convention applied mechanically and correctly, zero citation text altered or lost, scope exactly the 13 named files, divergence notes preserved byte-identical, table units marked once not per-row, no YAML frontmatter present.
